title: Raymond Brown, Clifford Brown and the Mag Darcy band
summary: Joseph names the violinist as Raymond Brown, also a trombonist, and lists players in the Mag Darcy band: Joe Harris, Tom Harris, Clifford Brown, Sammy Penn, Freddie Jones.
